rows.name: 1996 Japan All Company Annuity, Male -
rows.description:
TM-Country: Japan
Source of data: Japan Life Table 10th(1955) and 15th(1980)
Construction method: Comparing 10th and 15th table, calculate the decreasing rate of mortality per one year. 
Assuming this decreasing rate continues after 1980, mortality of each age is calculated based
 on person born in 1945.  
For example, mortality of age55 is calculated, as q55 of 15th table decreases in 20years
(1945+55-1980) at calculated decreasing rate.
In case of age60, 25years, age65, 30years, and so on.
But under age55, we calculate mortality as qx of 15th table decreases in 20years. 
Smoothed by Greville method. 
Rates of old ages(over 105) are calculated by Gompertz-Makeham method.
Minimum age: 16
Maximum age: 113
Number of decimal places: 5
